documentation.name: PORTFOLIO-REVIEW.md
documentation.summary: Design review of an earlier live build with scored areas, reference portfolios and a tiered action plan, plus code for the three most impactful changes. Its file references predate the later redesign and may not match the current source.

documentation.name: README.md
documentation.summary: Unmodified Vite React template README covering the official React plugins, the React Compiler and ESLint expansion. It says nothing about the portfolio itself; architect.md is the real project documentation.

documentation.name: architect.md
documentation.summary: Main architecture reference covering the tech stack, directory map, page layout, theme and language state, JSON content model, styling tokens, SEO build output and known gaps. It explains how to edit content and the index-matching rules that language files must follow.

documentation.name: robots.txt
documentation.summary: Crawler policy allowing all user agents and explicitly allowing AI search and assistant bots such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot. It also points crawlers to the site's sitemap.xml.

config.name: package.json
config.summary: npm manifest for the private ES module project, declaring React 19, Three.js, Framer Motion and lucide-react with Vite and ESLint tooling. Its build script chains the client build, the SSR build of src/entry-server.jsx and the prerender script.

config.name: vercel.json
config.summary: Vercel deployment configuration that sets the build command, the dist output directory and trailing slashes. It also applies security headers to all routes and long-lived cache headers to hashed assets and images.

config.name: en.json
config.summary: English content dictionary holding all UI strings, biography, experience, project case studies, FAQ and page metadata for the portfolio. It is the default-language reference whose keys and array lengths the French and Spanish files mirror.

config.name: es.json
config.summary: Spanish translation of the portfolio's content dictionary, covering navigation, biography, experience, project case studies, FAQ and es_ES page metadata with the same shape as the other language files.

config.name: fr.json
config.summary: French translation of the portfolio's content dictionary, covering navigation, biography, experience, project case studies, FAQ and fr_FR page metadata with the same shape as the other language files.

config.name: site.json
config.summary: Language-independent site data: profile contact details and photos, section order, tech stack, experience tags, project metadata, canonical URL, default language and the structured person details. Its experience and project arrays are matched by position to the translated items in the language files.

list.name: Application Shell
list.description: HTML template plus the client and build-time server entries that hydrate or render the root App, which composes the single-page portfolio.

list.name: Page Sections
list.description: Top-level portfolio regions, from the navbar and hero through projects, FAQ and contact, that combine translated copy with shared content and reusable components.

list.name: Reusable UI Components
list.description: Shared building blocks for the sections, including scroll and text reveal animations, section headings, magnetic buttons, language and theme controls, the marquee and case-study workflow steps.

list.name: 3D Brain Scene
list.description: Lazy-loaded Three.js hero visual, with procedural brain geometry generated in a Web Worker, a WebGL scene with shader waves, and an error boundary that preserves the CSS orb fallback.

list.name: State & Hooks
list.description: React contexts for the URL-derived language and the document-attribute theme, plus custom hooks for active-section tracking and the cursor-following card glow.

list.name: Content & Translations
list.description: JSON-driven content model: language-independent site data, English, French and Spanish dictionaries, and the accessor modules that expose them to the React tree.

list.name: Styling
list.description: Global Deep Ocean stylesheet with dark and light design tokens, responsive breakpoints and reduced-motion handling, plus the minimal App-level body reset.

list.name: Build, SEO & Deployment
list.description: Vite, ESLint and npm tooling, the per-language pre-render script that emits SEO pages and sitemap, Vercel deployment settings, and public crawler, manifest and 404 files.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Architecture reference in architect.md, the SEO/GEO audit, an earlier design review, and the unmodified Vite template README.

file:src/components/ScrollReveal.jsx.name: ScrollReveal.jsx
file:src/components/ScrollReveal.jsx.summary: Reusable Framer Motion wrapper that fades and slides its children up the first time they enter the viewport; used throughout the page sections.

file:src/components/SectionHeading.jsx.name: SectionHeading.jsx
file:src/components/SectionHeading.jsx.summary: Shared section header rendering a numbered eyebrow label over a large title whose last word is set in accent italic, revealed on scroll.

file:src/components/WorkflowSteps.jsx.name: WorkflowSteps.jsx
file:src/components/WorkflowSteps.jsx.summary: Small interactive explainer used in project case studies: clicking a step highlights it, advances a progress track, and announces its description to screen readers.

file:src/content.js.name: content.js
file:src/content.js.summary: Thin accessor over src/data/site.json that re-exports language-independent content (profile, sections, stack, experience tags, project metadata, last-updated date) and the featured project count.

file:src/sections/About.jsx.name: About.jsx
file:src/sections/About.jsx.summary: About section presenting translated intro paragraphs, a responsive profile photo with location caption, and animated stat cards in a bento layout.

file:src/sections/Experience.jsx.name: Experience.jsx
file:src/sections/Experience.jsx.summary: Experience section rendering translated career entries as a timeline, pairing each item by index with its language-independent tags from shared content.

file:src/sections/Exploring.jsx.name: Exploring.jsx
file:src/sections/Exploring.jsx.summary: Section describing what the author is currently exploring, showing a translated paragraph and a tag list inside a reveal-animated card.

file:src/sections/Faq.jsx.name: Faq.jsx
file:src/sections/Faq.jsx.summary: FAQ section listing translated question and answer cards written to be self-contained for people and AI assistants; the same items feed the FAQPage schema during pre-rendering.

file:src/sections/Projects.jsx.name: Projects.jsx
file:src/sections/Projects.jsx.summary: Projects section that splits translated project entries into detailed featured case-study cards and a compact grid of other projects, merging each with language-independent metadata such as tags, images, links, and an optional workflow explainer.

file:src/components/Controls.jsx.name: Controls.jsx
file:src/components/Controls.jsx.summary: Shared language switcher and theme toggle used by both the desktop nav bar and the mobile menu.

file:src/contexts/LanguageContext.jsx.name: LanguageContext.jsx
file:src/contexts/LanguageContext.jsx.summary: React context managing the active language, derived from the URL, with crossfaded switches, history integration, persistence, and document head updates.

file:src/contexts/ThemeContext.jsx.name: ThemeContext.jsx
file:src/contexts/ThemeContext.jsx.summary: Theme state layer that treats the document's data-theme attribute as an external store, staying consistent with the pre-paint inline script and dark-by-default pre-rendered HTML.

file:src/entry-server.jsx.name: entry-server.jsx
file:src/entry-server.jsx.summary: Server-side rendering entry used at build time by the pre-render script to produce the static HTML for each language.

file:src/i18n/translations.js.name: translations.js
file:src/i18n/translations.js.summary: Central i18n module that aggregates the per-language JSON copy and exposes the translations map, supported languages, default language, and language URL helper.

file:src/main.jsx.name: main.jsx
file:src/main.jsx.summary: Browser entry point that wraps App in theme, language, and motion providers, then hydrates pre-rendered markup or falls back to a fresh client render in development.

file:src/sections/Navbar.jsx.name: Navbar.jsx
file:src/sections/Navbar.jsx.summary: Floating glass navigation bar with section links and active-state highlighting that collapses into a mobile menu sheet below 960px.

file:src/components/CopyEmail.jsx.name: CopyEmail.jsx
file:src/components/CopyEmail.jsx.summary: Defines the contact email row: a mailto link plus a one-click copy button that confirms in place and falls back to the mail app when clipboard access is blocked.

file:src/components/Magnetic.jsx.name: Magnetic.jsx
file:src/components/Magnetic.jsx.summary: Provides a wrapper component that adds a magnetic hover effect to call-to-action buttons, limited to precise pointers and disabled under reduced motion.

file:src/components/RevealText.jsx.name: RevealText.jsx
file:src/components/RevealText.jsx.summary: Provides a CSS-only per-letter text reveal so the hero name animates from pre-rendered HTML without waiting for JavaScript.

file:src/components/SceneBoundary.jsx.name: SceneBoundary.jsx
file:src/components/SceneBoundary.jsx.summary: Provides the error boundary around the lazy three.js hero scene, so a failed chunk load leaves the CSS orb fallback visible rather than breaking the page.

file:src/sections/Contact.jsx.name: Contact.jsx
file:src/sections/Contact.jsx.summary: Implements the portfolio's closing contact section, combining localized copy with profile data for email, WhatsApp, phone, LinkedIn, and GitHub links.

file:src/sections/Hero.jsx.name: Hero.jsx
file:src/sections/Hero.jsx.summary: Implements the landing hero with an animated name, localized intro, and calls to action, deferring the three.js brain into a lazy chunk so 3D never competes with page content.

file:src/App.jsx.name: App.jsx
file:src/App.jsx.summary: Root React component module that assembles the single-page portfolio from its navbar, sections, technology marquee, and footer, shared by both the client and server render entries.

file:src/components/Marquee.jsx.name: Marquee.jsx
file:src/components/Marquee.jsx.summary: Reusable presentational component module providing the endlessly scrolling strip of technologies shown beneath the hero.

file:src/hooks/useActiveSection.js.name: useActiveSection.js
file:src/hooks/useActiveSection.js.summary: Custom React hook module that tracks which page section is currently in view so the navbar can highlight its matching link.

file:src/hooks/useGlowPointer.js.name: useGlowPointer.js
file:src/hooks/useGlowPointer.js.summary: Custom React hook module that drives the cursor-following glow on card borders by publishing pointer coordinates as CSS custom properties.

file:src/components/HeroScene.jsx.name: HeroScene.jsx
file:src/components/HeroScene.jsx.summary: React component that renders the hero's animated Three.js brain, loading its geometry through a Web Worker and running the WebGL scene with cortical shader waves, neuron pulses and pointer-driven rotation. It pauses off-screen, honours reduced motion, and leaves a CSS orb as the fallback when WebGL is unavailable.

file:src/components/brain.worker.js.name: brain.worker.js
file:src/components/brain.worker.js.summary: Web Worker that runs createBrain off the main thread on request and posts back the surfaces, neuron positions, edges and adjacency as plain serializable data.

file:src/components/brainGeometry.js.name: brainGeometry.js
file:src/components/brainGeometry.js.summary: Procedurally generates the hero brain's anatomy (folded hemispheres, cerebellum, brain stem) and a neuron network on the fold crests using seeded Perlin noise, so no model file has to be downloaded. Imported by both the worker and the main-thread scene.

file:eslint.config.js.name: eslint.config.js
file:eslint.config.js.summary: ESLint flat config that lints JS and JSX with the recommended, React Hooks and React Refresh rule sets, ignoring dist, .ssr and claude-seo. It also relaxes no-unused-vars for the `m` motion alias, which core ESLint cannot see used as a JSX tag.

file:public/404.html.name: 404.html
file:public/404.html.summary: Static, self-styled not-found page marked noindex, with links back to the English, French and Spanish versions of the portfolio.

file:public/site.webmanifest.name: site.webmanifest
file:public/site.webmanifest.summary: Web app manifest declaring the portfolio's name, standalone display mode, navy theme colors and 192px and 512px icons.

file:scripts/prerender.mjs.name: prerender.mjs
file:scripts/prerender.mjs.summary: Post-build script that renders the SSR bundle into one static HTML page per language with SEO head tags and JSON-LD. It also generates sitemap.xml, llms.txt and llms-full.txt from src/data, then removes the temporary .ssr output.

file:src/App.css.name: App.css
file:src/App.css.summary: Minimal stylesheet imported by the App component that only resets the body margin and sets its display to block.

file:src/index.css.name: index.css
file:src/index.css.summary: Global stylesheet for the whole site, defining the Deep Ocean design tokens with dark and light themes. It styles every section from nav and hero through projects, FAQ and footer, along with responsive breakpoints, animations and reduced-motion handling.

file:vite.config.js.name: vite.config.js
file:vite.config.js.summary: Vite build configuration that enables the React plugin and maps the `@` import alias to the src directory.
